LLM auditresponse for PKGBUILD:


<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The PKGBUILD downloads an AIMP skin archive from the official AIMP website (aimp.ru) over HTTPS, verifies it with a SHA256 checksum, and extracts it to /opt/aimp/Skins using bsdtar. All operations are confined to the package's own directory ($pkgdir). No code is executed from the downloaded archive, no data is exfiltrated, and no system files outside the AIMP scope are modified. The source is pinned with a checksum, the destination is the expected AIMP skins directory, and the use of bsdtar (from libarchive) is declared as a makedepends. This is consistent with standard AUR packaging for a skin package.
</details>
<evidence>

<summary>

</summary>
